block.guhs.mega_oven.lore: An industrial guh bakery of 3 by 2 by 2. Bakes in bulk and eats mountains of nibbles and grain. Empty hand: next programme. Sneak + empty hand: take out the baking.
block.guhs.knabbel_weerstation.lore: A weather tower. As long as it eats nibbles, every Weather Vadser up to 16 blocks away makes its weather over 150 blocks: your whole base!
block.guhs.sterrenkoepel.lore: The Vadsiness Monument. Feed it nibbles: every level lights up a new guh constellation, up to a whole sky full of guhs. Everybody gets something sweet from it.
block.guhs.draaimolen.lore: A guh fun fair ride. A cheese nibble is a ticket: tame guhs nearby ride along and get happy (then they do their chores better and run faster in a Guh Wheel).
block.guhs.wolkenvanger.lore: A dish for the roof that condenses passing little clouds into fluff. The higher it stands, the more fluff. A chest under it catches it.
gui.guhs.koepel.station.aan: The weather station runs: every Weather Vadser up to %2$s blocks from here makes its weather over %1$s blocks.
gui.guhs.koepel.station.uit: The weather station is asleep: it wants %s vadskracht and nibbles. Njeg...
gui.guhs.koepel.koepel.nieuw: ✦ A new constellation lights up on the Star Dome: %s (%s/%s)! Everybody feels rested for a while. VAHOEG!
gui.guhs.koepel.koepel.vol: The whole sky of guhs is lit already. Incalculably vahoeg!
gui.guhs.koepel.koepel.gevoerd: %s nibbles in the dome! %s more to the next constellation.
gui.guhs.koepel.koepel.stand: Star Dome: %s/%s constellations, %s more nibbles to the next one. The biggest givers:
gui.guhs.koepel.molen.rit: All aboard! The merry-go-round turns, guhs ride along.
gui.guhs.koepel.molen.slaapt: Ticket bought, but the merry-go-round wants %s vadskracht. Njeg!
gui.guhs.koepel.molen.kaartje: A cheese nibble is a ticket.
gui.guhs.koepel.vanger.stand: The cloud catcher catches a bit of fluff here every %s seconds.
gui.guhs.koepel.vanger.dak: The cloud catcher wants open sky above it: put it on the roof!
gui.guhs.koepel.vanger.uitlezing: One bit of fluff per %s seconds
